tasks.label: Recycle
tasks.command: cargo build -p locald-cli && cargo install --path crates/locald-cli --debug --force 2>&1 | tail -1 && (pgrep -f 'locald server start' | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; true) && sudo locald admin setup && locald up &disown && sleep 2 && locald ping && echo '✓ locald recycled'
